subject: Checking in on counsel review — Redwood Dedicated redlines
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@finplatform.com>, Paul Liu <paul.liu@finplatform.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's demo — Redwood Dedicated

Hi Sarah / Paul —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Scope we demoed: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) with autoscaling and canary rollouts.
- Primary success metrics: p95 inference latency < 150ms, throughput for 10k daily requests, target cost per 1k tokens <$2.
- Integrations called out: SSO via Okta, integration with FinPlatform KMS, 6-month pilot with production traffic on a single model.

Immediate next steps:
1) Paul to share your internal redlines to counsel / procurement (you mentioned legal@finplatform.com).
2) I attached a one-page mutual action plan (Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf) that maps milestones + owner dates.
3) Jordan (cc'd) will follow up on deployment windows and technical onboarding once legal greenlights.

If it helps, we can offer an extended pilot credit to cover burst traffic during onboarding — happy to discuss on the next call.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan)

Thanks — I’ll check back mid-week unless I hear from you.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's demo — Redwood Dedicated

Hi Marissa —

Great demo — thanks to you and Jordan. I shared the MAP internally and looped in Paul (procurement). I’ll get the redlines to our legal counsel this afternoon; they usually take 48–72 hours to respond.

A couple of asks from our side: can you send the standard T&Cs and the pricing appendix you referenced? Also confirm whether the pilot credit is time-limited or usage-limited.

Paul, can you confirm who will be the primary procurement contact for this?

Thanks,
Sarah

FinPlatform Inc.

Date: 2026-03-13T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's demo — Redwood Dedicated

Hi all —

Per Sarah’s note, thanks for taking this through. Quick update from our side: we uploaded the standard T&Cs + pricing appendix to the Drive folder (link below) and sent our proposed redline-friendly contract to legal@finplatform.com earlier today. DocuSign envelope is ready if counsel prefers to sign after redline agreement: https://na1.docusign.com/Redwood_FP_FP-2026-031

A few clarifying items counsel often asks about — I’ve noted them here in case it helps speed review:
- Data retention defaults and option for a 30/90/365 day setting (we can provide an enterprise retention contract appendix).
- KMS integration: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM; happy to add a short integration doc.
- Audit logs: we can provide 12-month or custom retention with add-on pricing.

Jordan and Diego are standing by for any technical Qs counsel wants to route to us. If procurement is short on time, we can do a 15-min call with counsel + procurement to walk through the redlines and avoid back-and-forth.

Drive (T&Cs + pricing): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodMAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FP-2026-031

—
